exact_statement: For every pair of Boolean signs f,c on any finite uniform physical cube, put g=fc and let r(c) be the affine dimension over F2 of the nonzero Walsh support of c. Then |H(g)-H(f)|<=r(c), and either physical restriction has rank no greater than r(c). At every node of any finite adaptive stopping tree of actual restrictions, Phi=r(c)+H(g)-H(f) lies in [0,2r(c)], and Delta(g)-Delta(f)=Phi-average(Phi_children)-[r(c)-average(r(c_children))]. Thus all signed corrections telescope from ONE original reserve with both full terminals and rank refunds retained. If c avoids all queried coordinates, actual queried influence equals baseline queried influence and ONE already funded Phi_root suffices to transfer any supplied K-good baseline policy. If c is queried, the exact influence correction E[1_{c flips}f f_prime] is retained. Universal admission Phi_root<=K I(g) is FALSE for every finite K: opposite-slice point defects in dimension m+1, m>=2, give Phi=m, I(g)=(m+1)2^-m and actual query correction zero.
hypotheses: Boolean signs on the SAME finite uniform physical cube
actual restrictions of ONE root multiplier; no renewed dictionary or gate labels
both full terminal entropy and influence retained
the K-good transfer requires a supplied baseline policy and preexisting ORIGINAL unused reserve; it does not supply one
queried-influence equality requires multiplier independent of queried coordinates; otherwise retain the exact signed influence transfer
